comparison.objective: Swap a filter beneath a spring-shut cover; candidate adjusts and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a pedal continuously while exchanging filters versus counterholding, recessed tool use, fine collar rotation, torque-limited locking, and guarded cycling.
comparison.success_condition: New filter seated, old filter binned, cover shut versus two repeatable damped stops. Candidate rebound/overload/drift limits remain partly unspecified.
comparison.reason: Generic bimanual stabilization is the only meaningful commonality.
